Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: se-chukei
Message:
feat(dashboard): refactor tempserver for improved state management and webhook integration

- Enhanced global fleet state management with persistent storage.
- Introduced outbound webhook functionality for TVU events.
- Added support for dynamic stream registration and state updates.
- Implemented Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time dashboard updates.
- Improved error handling and logging for better debugging.
- Updated telemetry monitoring routes and static file serving.
- Introduced environment variable configuration for sensitive data.

feat(client): add Tailscale IP discovery helper

- Implemented a Kotlin object to discover Tailscale IPv4 addresses.
- Added logging for successful and failed IP discovery attempts.

chore(dashboard): add .env file for configuration

- Created a .env file to store sensitive configuration values for TVU integration.

chore(dashboard): initialize dashboard state file

- Added a JSON file to initialize the global fleet state with default values.

chore(scripts): create webhook registration script

- Added a bash script to automate the registration of webhooks with TVU Command Center.
- Included steps for generating password hash and logging in to obtain session ID.
